notes: The page says it is mainly an education program and stipend details come at orientation. It serves St. Louis regional youth.
name: Outdoor Youth Corps
what_you_do: Crews of 10 to 20 youth do nature care, city farming and invasive plant removal. They also do community projects. They get career panels, mock interviews and college visits.
who_can_apply: St. Louis region youth ages 16 to 20.
pay_detail: Paid $15.00 per hour as a stipend. Bus passes, snacks and lunch provided.
duration: Three programs a year (spring break, summer, fall)
deadline_text: Fall series closed when checked. A waitlist form is on the page.
how_to_apply: Join the waitlist form on the program page for future seasons.
